scope: AC1018 TABLE title/header/data row fill-none and fill-color DWG output

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: After the row text CMC fields, selected title/header/data fill-none Boolean values are followed by selected title/header/data fill CMC fields; row alignments follow.

implementation.codec: DRW_Table::encodeDwgWithExtension now validates and emits fill-none bits 0x100/0x200/0x400 and fill-color bits 0x800/0x1000/0x2000. Selected fill CMCs accept only C0/ByLayer, C1/ByBlock and C3/ACI 1..255 with no RGB, name/book payload or unknown CMC flags. Unselected fill values must remain default. The body order is fill-none Booleans, fill CMCs, then row alignments.
implementation.readback_model: The prior row-text-color slice's normalized CMC payload index is shared by the row fill-color arrays, preserving the selected ACI index on readback.
implementation.compatibility: No public virtuals, public struct layout or fixture files were changed. Unsupported fill values remain refused.

checks: Readback preserves each selected fill-none Boolean, CMC method/index and alignment
Wire walk verifies fill-none Booleans precede title/header/data fill CMCs, which precede alignments
The TABLE body cursor reaches its exact bound and the following sentinel remains readable
Selected truecolor and unselected nondefault fill values refuse without publishing output
generated_control.fixture_policy: Generated in memory from test code; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests -j4 passed with repository warning-as-error settings

limits: The generated vector proves writer/parser consistency but not physical producer ordering.
Native fill rendering and style precedence remain unqualified.
Parsed TABLE source-range replay and broad TABLE support remain gated.
